@isTest private class SystemTestEventBusLifecycleTest { @isTest static void localTestAndEventBusLifecycle() { System.assert(Test.isRunningTest()); System.assertEquals('01s000000000001', Test.getStandardPricebookId()); System.assertEquals('01s000000000001', Test.getStandardPricebookId()); System.assertEquals(false, Test.isSoqlStubDefined(Account.SObjectType)); Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new SystemTestEventBusLifecycleMock()); HttpRequest mockRequest = new HttpRequest(); mockRequest.setEndpoint('https://example.test/system-test'); mockRequest.setMethod('GET'); HttpResponse mockResponse = new Http().send(mockRequest); System.assertEquals(201, mockResponse.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('system-test-eventbus-mock', mockResponse.getBody()); ExternalServiceTest service = (ExternalServiceTest)Test.getExternalService(); HttpResponse callback = service.sendCallback(new HttpRequest()); System.assertEquals(200, callback.getStatusCode()); HttpResponse asyncResponse = new TestAsyncHttp().executeHttpRequest(new HttpRequest()); System.assertEquals(200, asyncResponse.getStatusCode()); SystemTestEventBusLifecycleState.delivered = 0; eventbus.TestEventService.publishEvent('EventBus_Tail__e', new Map<String,Object>{'Payload__c' => 'deliver'}); System.assertEquals(0, SystemTestEventBusLifecycleState.delivered); Test.getEventBus().deliver(); System.assertEquals(1, SystemTestEventBusLifecycleState.delivered); Messaging.ActionableNotification notification = new Messaging.ActionableNotification.Builder().withActionIdentifier('local').build(); Messaging.ActionResult action = Test.testNotificationActionHandler(new SystemTestEventBusLifecycleMock(), notification); System.assertEquals(false, action.isSuccess()); Test.startTest(); System.enqueueJob(new SystemTestEventBusLifecycleJob()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals('SUCCESS', SystemTestEventBusLifecycleJob.result); } }
